verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's API docs say you can programmatically manage API keys, so issuing credentials for an agent appears possible. Nothing in the pack shows those keys can be scoped to specific permissions, datasets, or environments, or tied to an agent identity. missing for 10: documented per-key permission scopes, least-privilege or read-only key options for agents, MCP-specific credential scoping, independent or hands-on corroboration.
